question:
Study the given table and answer the question that follows.

What percentage of the total sample indicated that Rock is their favourite style of music (rounded off to 2 decimal places)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Rock total = 9 (18 - 20) + 7 (21 - 30) + 13 (31 +) = 29

Total respondents = 28 (18 - 20) + 32 (21 - 30) + 46 (31 +) = 106

Percentage = (Total who prefer Rock / Total respondents) × 100

⇒ (29 / 106) × 100 = 27.36% (rounded off to two decimal places)

**Therefore, 27.36% of the total sample indicated that Rock is their favourite style of music.**
